disclaimer: Engineering guidance to keep the build clean and defensible. Not legal advice — Mike confirms specifics with his own attorney.

tcpa.consentModel: A customer who called in or booked an estimate establishes a business relationship. Capture and log that consent event with a timestamp and source before any automated outbound.

quietHours.rule: No automated messages before 8:00 AM or after 9:00 PM local time. Queue anything outside that window.

tcpa.throttle: Never blast. Space outreach so it reads as a small company, not a spam cannon.

callRecordingAndAiDisclosure.disclosureLine: Hi, thanks for calling Art-is-Tree — you may be speaking with our automated assistant, and calls can be recorded for quality. How can I help with your trees?

dataPrivacy.classification: sensitive PII (names, addresses, phones, photos, property history)

ownerLocation.principle: Mike tracking himself, on his own phone, by choice — no third-party privacy issue.
ownerLocation.requirement: Clear ON/OFF, working-hours-only, never running after hours.

contractsAndCredentials.signedContractPhotos: Records, not e-signatures. Fine to store and file; do not represent as anything else.
contractsAndCredentials.proofOfInsurance: Always send the current, valid COI. Never send an expired one; never overstate coverage.

outboundGate.description: Every automated outbound message MUST pass all of these checks before sending.
